quotes.text: Each team still needs tools built for its job. What they need is one shared customer file that can connect the separate records.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Captures the core idea of a customer data platform without forcing everyone into one app.

quotes.text: If sales calls someone a high value customer while marketing uses a different calculation, the customer experience splits again. A shared measure gives everyone one agreed way to look at the question.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why shared metric definitions matter for a consistent customer experience.

quotes.text: Before anyone sends a windback offer, the team checks the profile and finds an open service case. Now the right action is to solve the issue first, not send a sales email that ignores the problem.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Shows that AI predictions are signals that still need human judgment and context.

quotes.text: A segment identifies a group based on facts and rules. Someone still needs to decide whether contact makes sense, which channel fits, and whether the message respects the customer's current situation.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Warns against treating every segment as an automatic mailing list.

quotes.text: More data doesn't mean you can use it however you want. The data has to match the permissions, laws and internal rules for each customer.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A clear reminder that privacy and consent come before data use.

takeaways: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data is a customer data platform that maps, matches and de-duplicates records from many systems into one unified customer profile.
Measures, enrichment and AI predictions such as churn turn profiles into answers, but predictions are signals that still need human review.
Segments and destinations put the shared profile to work across sales, service and marketing, while consent, privacy and access control must be designed in from the start.
hook: When sales, service and marketing each see a different version of the same customer, people get the wrong offers and repeat themselves. This episode explains Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data for CRM, marketing and data teams. You learn how one unified customer profile, measures and segments lead to better-informed customer conversations.
